Section 3306(a)(1)(B) defines an employer as someone who employed at least one individual on each of some 10 days during the calendar year, with each day being in a different calendar week. Alice employed Bob on 12 dates in 2017 spanning 11 different calendar weeks, which satisfies the 10-day requirement. The answer "Entailment" is correct. The only minor risk would be if "different calendar week" is interpreted differently (e.g., week starting Sunday vs Monday), but the standard ISO week calculation confirms 11 unique weeks.
